decision: Enable no automatic profile default without every held-out class gate; otherwise retain explicitly configured policy values
exclusions: none; failed, cancelled, missing and not-run tasks remain unsuccessful
selection: Only eligible strategies may compete; lowest total attributable USD cost, then lowest p95 latency, then strategy id. No eligible strategy means no enabled measured default.
uncertainty: Exact one-sided binomial bounds are descriptive for these synthetic tasks, not a claim of independent representative population sampling. Repeated executions and renamed/paraphrased templates do not increase independent sample count.
rollback: quality floor violation or serious review/generation failure
memory/context configuration changes requiring refreshed P5-08 evidence
release_limit: P8 must repeat relevant qualification with actual child isolation, final integration and packaged CLI
